newsitem.title: USA: Fountain Powerboat sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Fountain Powerboat sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Fountain Powerboat Industries Inc said its board of directors approved on Wednesday a three-for-two common stock split.
The stock split will be payable on August 14 to shareholders of record on August 1.
In addition, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, R.M. Fountain said in a statement on Wednesday that he expects the company to achieve record earnings for the new fiscal year which began July 1.
Fountain Powerboat designs and makes deepwater sport and sport fishing power boats, luxury cruisers and racing boats.
